row_records.whole_source_visual_note: Uppermost row contains tall left-bowl start, low angular/arc chain, a low descending shoulder before short bend and tall loop, then a separated barred construction and bowl descender. Repeated strict contexts clip lower-row ink and some descender returns; primary first-group partition is not complete.
Second row begins stacked lobes, angular ink, open arc and tall left-bowl construction; several lower descenders intersect row contexts. Far-right arc proposal lacks fullpeer individual coverage.

Third row starts open crook, low multiple humps, crossed high-stem and small loop/lobes; intermediate bowl descenders and final overhead curl need owner separation. Peer remainder leaves most row unsegmented.

Fourth row is broken into several spaced clusters with tall looping and descending constructions and overhead marks. Printed greeting below is separate; neither ordinary print nor upper-row descenders complete cipher bodies.
Fifth row begins to the right of printed greeting. Short bent, lobed, low humps and tall stems occur with an overhead mark and isolated dot. Fullpeer initial work does not complete primary groups.

Sixth row begins a locally identifiable low shoulder then crook/lower bowl, followed by a visible gap and open arc. Subsequent crossed and looped bodies, raised mark and terminal ink retain unresolved ownership.

Seventh row has low shoulders and crook at left followed by taller loops and crossed stems. A narrow detached tall-loop context in primary is beyond fullpeer individual coverage; multiple right groups remain a remainder.

Eighth row begins small hooked/bowl-descending and lobed constructions, then crossed stem/low humps. Primary later low-shoulder and crook contexts are shifted relative to peer feature sites; no ordinal alignment.

Ninth upper row contains tall looped/crook and multi-hump start, then descending loop and pointed/bent forms. Later caps, terminal raised curl and detached stroke keep boundary ambiguity; no body census.

First lower row has tall left-bowl/crook/descender start and separated middle/right clusters. Small slants between/end clusters remain unplaced; all later group ownership lacks independent individual coverage.

Second lower row includes an underlined two-construction context and isolated crook/bowl before longer mixed clusters. Underline is not assigned to a unit boundary; initial high-bar/cup ownership remains uncertain.

Third lower row includes tall looping descender, paired emphasis-like ink, a long isolated horizontal stroke, later high/low bodies with overhead curls and separated slants. Marks never become invented punctuation or bodies.

Final lower row ends early with mixed tall loops, short arcs/lobes, and a large terminal curl/dot. Peer remainder includes primary later constructions; terminal flourish not attached to a fabricated boundary.
